status.heading: Subscription status
status.trialBody: Your free trial runs until {{date}}. No card required.
status.cancellingBody: Your subscription has been cancelled; full AI access continues until {{date}}.
status.pastDueBody: The last payment failed. Update your card by {{date}}; your access continues without interruption until then.
status.stoppedTitle: AI reply drafting and content generation are paused
status.stoppedBody: Your trial or payment grace period has ended. Your data stays safe, customer messages still arrive in the inbox and notify your team, scheduled posts still publish, and the test chat keeps working. Subscribe or update your payment method to resume AI features.
status.exemptBody: This workspace is exempted from billing pauses by the operator.

return.verifyingBody: Waiting for subscription confirmation from the payment provider. This page updates automatically.
return.verifiedBody: Your payment has been verified and your plan is active.
return.unverifiedBody: We have not received confirmation yet. If you completed payment, it usually arrives within moments; reload or check again.

notifications.payment_failed: Subscription payment failed. Update your payment method by {{date}} to avoid interruption.
notifications.paused: AI drafting is paused because your trial or subscription ended. Messages still arrive in your inbox.
notifications.activated: Your subscription is active; AI drafting and content generation are enabled.
